what: Today's lead-tooling host scenario caught three more deliberate faults. Each clean baseline passed, the deliberate fault failed at its intended assertion, and exact restoration passed.
cause: Ignoring the requested Node pin failed at host.test.ts:195:62. Removing the native pnpm directory from PATH failed the versions equality at 194:70.
